title: 数星星的孩子
pages_note: Read off the 目录 (教材 PDF index 12–13: the lesson at the foot of index 12, its 阅读 at the head of index 13) and confirmed on each rendered page: 第八课 runs pp. 82–91, 第九课 starts p. 92. p. 84 carries 生字, 词语, 专有名词 and 句子. 课堂练习 is pp. 85–88 (描一描写一写 85, 读一读 85–86, 用一用 86, 扩展与替换 86–87, 想一想说一说 87, 对话 87–88, 课堂游戏 88); the 阅读 text is pp. 89–90 with its 想一想 and 日积月累 on p. 91.

课文.text_note: Fully pinyin-annotated in the book. Not reproduced, by the same decision as L05: docs/chinese.md § 8 holds every 课文 back until the owner says where it may live.

生字.gloss_note: character and 拼音 are the book's; the gloss is authored here in both languages and is not printed in the book. 数 is listed as shǔ, the verb to count, which is how the 课文 uses it throughout (数星星, 数得清); the noun reading shù is not taught here.

gloss.zh: 一个一个地点数目：数星星
gloss.en: count, as in 数星星, count the stars

gloss.en: lean against, as in 靠着奶奶
face upward, tilt the head back

gloss.zh: 两个地方隔着一段路：离它不远；离开

专有名词.section_note: As in L03: the book prints 专有名词 (Proper nouns) between 词语 and 句子 on p. 84, with the pinyin capitalised as a name. Kept as the book has it; the lesson page may ignore it.

句子.zh: 那么多星星，你能数得清吗？
句子.py: nà me duō xīng xing, nǐ néng shǔ de qīng ma?

where.zh: 课本第86–87页 扩展与替换

ladder: 那么多星星，你能数得清吗？
句型.substitutions_note: The ladder is on p. 86 and the blue 替换 table on p. 87: the sentence split as 那么多星星 / ， / 你能数 / 得 / 清 / 吗？, with 那么多星星, 你能数 and 清 underlined (the comma is not underlined, so it is a part of its own) and 得 and 吗 printed in red as the fixed parts; each row swaps the three underlined parts. Added as the book prints it, as in L03 and L04. The pattern label is authored, from the red 得 and the ladder.

读一读.page_break_note: the first three rows are on p. 85, under 描一描写一写; the last five on p. 86, above 用一用

阅读.text_note: same copyright hold as the 课文. The text runs pp. 89–90; all three margin entries are on p. 89, each after a ★, and p. 90 has none. 手术 and 着急 carry example phrases under them rather than a gloss, kept here in brackets as L04 did with 帮忙. p. 91 carries the reading's 想一想，说一说 (three questions) and 日积月累 (兴趣是最好的老师。——［美国、瑞士］爱因斯坦), neither reproduced.
